facts.fact: Nugi Technologies says Cross River State's 360Lands digital registry has processed 330 applications, 188 Certificates of Occupancy and 142 consent applications, since implementation.

Nugi Technologies says 360Lands integrates the state Ministry of Lands, the Geographic Information Agency, the Surveyor General's Office and Physical Planning, with parcels viewable on satellite maps through a GIS.

NGA.note: Link to tax is only an expectation of the company, not stated in service.

facts.fact: Nugi Technologies says Cross River State's 360Lands digital land registry is in service and has processed 330 title and consent applications, with field officers capturing ownership data into a searchable property database.
Nugi Technologies says applications for a Certificate of Occupancy on 360Lands can be submitted online or at designated offices.
